label: champ_0220_stopper_02
text: You can’t go any farther until you win!

label: champ_0220_ground_01
text: Now then, let’s get this started, eh?[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: champ_0220_ground_02
text: Let good ol’ Rika be the first of the Elite Four\nto take you on![VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: champ_0220_ground_03
text: I’d say I’ll go easy on you, but...I’d be lying!\nThink fast![VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: champ_0220_ground_04
text: Talk about unfair. No way was I ever gonna win\nthat one.[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: champ_0220_ground_05
text: Still, though, what a great battle. Felt good even\nto lose![VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: champ_0220_ground_06
text: Not a whole lot of Trainers have the skill to make\nit past the Elite Test...\c\nBut who knows?[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: champ_0220_ground_07
text: I’m beginning to think you might be one of the\nfew that do, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: champ_0220_ground_08
text: Better stay on your toes, though—the second of\nthe Elite Four is stronger than me![VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: champ_0220_ground_09
text: You’re up next, squirt! Come on out![VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: champ_0220_steel_02
text: Oh wow! Did you lose, Rika?[VAR 0x0114(0014)]

label: champ_0220_ground_10
text: Yeah, I did... [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0201)]HShe’s no pushover, let me tell you![VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: champ_0220_ground_11
text: I’ll be watching from the side. Avenge me if you\ncan, eh?[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: champ_0220_ground_12
text: I’ll be watching to see just how far you make\nit, kiddo.[VAR 0x0114(0013)]
